brand.name: YaYa
brand.description: Created by Carlos Guillermo, originally launched in the Dominican Republic in 2019; United Cigars gave it its U.S. debut at the PCA 2022 trade show. Name references a woman nicknamed 'Yaya' who rolled her own blends, from whom Guillermo and friends used to take cigars as kids.
brand.origin_country: Dominican Republic (rolled at Tabacalera Magia, Santiago)
brand.founded: 2019 (DR); U.S. launch via United Cigars, July 2022 (PCA)

line.name: YaYa
line.strength: Medium, trending medium-full in the final third
line.notes: A later variant, 'YaYa Bagua Robusto', also exists (per 2024 halfwheel/Cigar Coop coverage) but is not represented in our photo library, which covers only the original 4-vitola lineup.

vitolas.name: Robusto
vitolas.notes: Mac filename 'Robuto' is a typo for Robusto.
